names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Ευσέβιος, Ζήνων, Βιτάλιος και Νέων», with the rank word left off.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 427, «Мученик Виталий Керкирский» — his is the one of the twelve the calendar heads with the rank written out in front of the name rather than abbreviated after a comma — with that rank word left off. The day's own line declines the forename alone, so the toponymic is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it. Measured against the gate's own key function before it was written: 'виталии керкирскии' has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Саторния , Иакисхола , Фавстиана , Ианнуария , Марсалия , Евфрасия , Маммия , Мурина , Зинона , Евсевия , Неона и Виталия (ок. 63).»

attestations.note: The day's third entry of five, ONE LINE NAMING TWELVE MEN, and he is the twelfth of them. ELEVEN OF THE TWELVE ALREADY HAD FOLDERS and this batch upgrades all eleven; the twelfth, «Мурин», had none and arrived in batch ru-04-28-1. `day-candidates.mjs` listed only seven of the eleven for this menologion day, because the corpus keeps `zeno-of-corfu`, `eusebius-of-corfu`, `neon-of-corfu` and `vitalius-of-corfu` on the menologion's 29/4; all four were found with `ls -d saints/*corfu*`, which is the check BRIEF-RUSSIAN §5 names for a folder standing on a different menologion day. THE DAY PAGE PRINTS NO HYMN UNDER ANY OF THE TWELVE: its four hymns are a troparion and a kontakion of the apostles and a troparion and a величание of the bishop of Turov. NO `related` ROW TO «Мурин» WAS WRITTEN: the Russian life has him die alone at the door of the maiden's prison, healed and taught by her and not by the apostles, and this corpus's Corfu rows follow the sub-groups the passion itself makes — the seven of the cauldron to one another, the four of the fire to one another, and all eleven to the two apostles. Whether all twelve should be related to one another on the strength of «и иных, с ними пострадавших» is an author question and nothing was written on it. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Ευσέβιος, Ζήνων, Βιτάλιος και Νέων»

attestations.note: The life page is one entry for all four and heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole body is one paragraph: these saints were of the inhabitants of Corfu, the first drawn by the preaching of the apostles Jason and Sosipater and fervent fellow workers in their apostolic labour; the ruler Kerkyllinos hunted them down, stripped and scourged them hard, imprisoned them when they refused to sacrifice to the idols, and then lit a great fire and threw them into it. **The line names each of the four, so it is one folder per man** — no year, no kindred, no trade and nothing that tells them apart beyond the names, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. The `related` rows are the other three of the company and the two apostles through whom the page says they believed, all of whom the page itself names. It prints no hymn and names no relic.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 28 апреля ст. ст. closes «(ок. 63)», about 63, for the twelve martyrs it names, and its life page life946 says the apostles reached Corfu «в 63 году», the martyrdoms following on the same mission. The folder had no year of any kind before. No day or month of death is given anywhere and none was inferred.
